# PSA Airlines

> PSA Airlines is the regional carrier for American Airlines Group, offering career opportunities for pilots, flight attendants, and aircraft maintenance technicians.

PSA Airlines operates as a regional airline subsidiary of American Airlines Group, based in Charlotte and operating aircraft like the CRJ 900. The site focuses on recruitment, career development, and employee benefits for aviation professionals.

## Key Topics

- PSA Airlines
- American Airlines Group
- Aviation careers
- Pilot recruitment

- Aircraft Maintenance Technician (AMT)

- [Which Aviation Career Is for You?](https://psaairlines.com/which-aviation-career-is-for-you): Aviation career guide covering pilots, mechanics, and flight attendant positions
